primary.version: Modern Steam/Windows route for the original Final Fantasy VII
primary.why: The original Final Fantasy VII is distinct from later remake projects and has modern console, mobile, and PC re-releases. For the original game, Windows has the strongest capture/mod/settings route through the PC release family, and no platform-exclusive story content exists elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Use the modern Windows/Steam release for the main original-game capture and verify any mod choices before recording. If purist presentation matters, compare against the original PlayStation release before locking the archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Supplemental seed: verify translation, music, FMV, and mod choices before final capture because this entry was not part of Sami?s current spine export. Do not conflate this original-game entry with the later Final Fantasy VII remake project.

entries.title: Final Fantasy
entries.definitive_edition: Final Fantasy Pixel Remaster on Windows for the main run

emulation.notes: Use native Windows Pixel Remaster. Use GBA/PSP only if doing a secondary bonus-content audit.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Pixel Remaster at current patch level

primary.why: Pixel Remaster is Square Enix's current official high-fidelity route for the original Final Fantasy, with modern graphics/audio and PC capture flexibility. PSP/GBA-era extra dungeons should be treated as secondary completeness content rather than replacing the modern main route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Final Fantasy Pixel Remaster on Windows with current patch options. If Sami wants every bonus dungeon from older ports, add a secondary PSP/GBA route for only that content.

secondary.exclusive_content: Older-port bonus dungeons and extra content not treated as part of the Pixel Remaster route
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the port-exclusive bonus content after the Pixel Remaster main run if Sami wants historical completeness.
secondary.why: Pixel Remaster is the fidelity route, but older enhanced ports added extras worth a separate completeness audit.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch options such as font/music/boost settings. Do not assume Pixel Remaster includes every bonus from older enhanced ports.

entries.title: Final Fantasy IV

primary.why: The Pixel Remaster is Square Enix's current official 2D route for Final Fantasy IV across modern platforms, and Windows gives the best capture path. The original SNES/Super Famicom and the 3D remake remain important comparison routes because they differ in presentation and sometimes content/balance.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows/Steam Pixel Remaster for the main archive route. Record whether boost features, font/music options, or other modern assists are enabled, and use original hardware or the 3D remake only when preserving those distinct versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Pixel Remaster changes graphics, audio, UI, and available assists, and does not replace every older enhanced/remake variant.
